symptom: High-sharpness crops still contained empty eyes, black mouth cavities, and wax skin.
root_cause: The contact-sheet script treated face width, Laplacian sharpness, and dHash as a complete pass.
patch: Automated metrics are now prechecks only; structured manual checks and per-subject decisions are required for approval.

symptom: High-density lead repairs were shrunk into the semantic master and damaged again during MPS enlargement.
root_cause: The old pipeline composited repair assets at semantic-master resolution.
patch: Accepted high-density repairs are bound before MPS and composited once onto a uniformly enlarged base.

symptom: Defects were found serially, causing repeated generation, review, compositing, and evidence work.
root_cause: The workflow lacked a complete pre-MPS defect inventory and invocation budget.
patch: One-plan workflow: at most one whole-image edit, one MPS run, one repair-pack composite, and one retry per failed region.

symptom: High pixel count still looked painted and unreal: material transitions were smeared, surfaces too clean, and detail did not vary with depth.
root_cause: The skill named object details but did not classify source/target look, distinguish intended optical softness, or gate material construction and style consistency.
patch: Add visual routing, layered prompts, a representative crop trial for risky reconstruction, and native-pixel appearance checks before MPS.
